characters.name: SK_Knight
characters.subject: one COMPLETE standing knight from head to soles of BOTH BOOTS, stylized realistic game hero with broad clean shapes and smooth surfaces, sturdy adult human proportions, fitted charcoal steel plate armour, simple rounded pauldrons, layered breastplate, dark leather belt and short split tabard, iron gauntlets and knee-high armoured boots, closed helmet with narrow visor, restrained ornament, satin worn metal, no horns, no spikes, no filigree, no cape, no weapon, empty open hands, arms clear of torso, straight separated legs and visible feet, no base
rig_args: SwordRaise=3:A heavy armoured knight raises his right hand from a ready grip to straight overhead in the first 0.3 seconds, as if lifting a greatsword attached later, then holds that pose for the rest of the clip, chest out, feet planted, no swing or jump.

Scrub=3:A standing knight holds his right hand in a tool grip at chest height in front of him and scrubs it rapidly side to side, like brushing teeth, feet planted. The toothbrush is attached later; do not create a prop or another character.
Sigh=3:A standing knight lets his shoulders drop in a long heavy disappointed sigh, head tilting down and shaking slowly side to side, then straightens up.
